title: Wack 100 Trying To Convince Antonio Brown To Join The Dallas Cowboys
htmlContent:
Antonio Brown was let go by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers two weeks ago.

"He is no longer a Buc," Arians said. "That's the end of the story. Let's talk about the guys that went out there and won the game."

"I'm not talking about him. He's no longer part of the Bucs."

He refused to enter the game against the New York Jets because of his health regarding his ankle.

Per SI, he will have surgery on Jan. 18.

“We have attempted, multiple times throughout the week, to schedule an evaluation by an outside orthopedic specialist, yet Antonio has not complied,” the Buccaneers added. “Maintaining the health and wellness of our players is of the utmost importance to our organization.”

Brown recently jumped on the Clubhouse app in Tapped Daily to discuss his side of the story. All while being on Clubhouse he was talking about his music.

Antonio Brown has been spotted all over Los Angeles with the likes of Kanye West, Floyd Mayweather, Madonna, Jason Lee, Julia Fox, Stat Quo, Top Dawg, and Wack 100 to name a few.

Speaking of Wack 100, he was on Clubhouse in the Blood House room on Friday evening and revealed that he has been trying to convince Antonio Brown to join the Dallas Cowboys.

"And I have been convincing AB to go to the Cowboys.

Antonio Brown said he wants to play next year, but he is focused on getting his body right.

Brown recently said “It probably wasn't necessary or professional.” referencing the way he left the field on in the third quarter against the Jets.
